q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विटामिन वसा में घुलनशील (fat-soluble) है?
e:
Vitamin K (Phylloquinone) is fat-soluble, whereas Vitamins B-complex and C are water-soluble (विटामिन K वसा में घुलनशील है, जबकि विटामिन B-कॉम्प्लेक्स और C जल में घुलनशील हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Fat-soluble vitamins are A, D, E, and K (stored in liver and adipose tissue).
2. Water-soluble vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, B12, and C) are excreted in urine and must be replenished regularly (except B12, which is stored in the liver).
3. Vitamin K is essential for blood clotting as it helps synthesize prothrombin in the liver.
4. Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) is easily destroyed by heat during cooking.
qe: Which of the following vitamins is fat-soluble?

q:
सूची-I (विटामिन) को सूची-II (रासायनिक नाम) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. विटामिन B1
2. विटामिन B2
3. विटामिन B3
4. विटामिन B6
सूची-II:
(a) पाइरिडॉक्सिन
(b) नियासिन
(c) थायमिन
(d) राइबोफ्लेविन
e:
Vitamin B1 is Thiamine, B2 is Riboflavin, B3 is Niacin (Nicotinic acid), and B6 is Pyridoxine (विटामिन B1 = थायमिन, B2 = राइबोफ्लेविन, B3 = नियासिन, B6 = पाइरिडॉक्सिन)। Hence 1-c, 2-d, 3-b, 4-a.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. B1 deficiency causes Beriberi; B2 deficiency causes Cheilosis (cracking of lip corners) and glossitis.
2. B3 deficiency causes Pellagra, characterized by the 4 Ds: Dermatitis, Diarrhoea, Dementia, and Death.
3. B5 is Pantothenic acid (deficiency: Burning Feet Syndrome); B7 is Biotin (Vitamin H).
4. B6 deficiency causes microcytic anaemia and peripheral neuropathy.
qe:
Match List-I (Vitamin) with List-II (Chemical Name) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Vitamin B1
2. Vitamin B2
3. Vitamin B3
4. Vitamin B6
List-II:
(a) Pyridoxine
(b) Niacin
(c) Thiamine
(d) Riboflavin

q: विटामिन A (रेटिनॉल) की कमी से निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा नेत्र रोग होता है?
e:
Vitamin A (Retinol) deficiency causes Night Blindness (Nyctalopia) and Xerophthalmia (dryness of conjunctiva and cornea) (विटामिन A की कमी से रतौंधी और जीरोफ्थैल्मिया होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Beta-carotene in carrots, papaya, mango, and golden rice is a precursor (provitamin) of Vitamin A.
2. Bitot's spots (foamy white patches on the conjunctiva) are a classic clinical sign of Vitamin A deficiency.
3. Vitamin A is also called the 'Anti-infective vitamin' because it maintains epithelial tissue integrity.
4. Glaucoma is caused by increased intraocular pressure, while cataract is clouding of the eye lens.
qe: Deficiency of Vitamin A (Retinol) leads to which of the following eye disorders?

q: निम्नलिखित में से किस विटामिन में कोबाल्ट केंद्रीय धातु परमाणु के रूप में उपस्थित होता है?
e:
Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin) is the only vitamin that contains a metal ion—Cobalt (Co) (विटामिन B12 या सायनोकोबालामिन में कोबाल्ट धातु पाई जाती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Deficiency of Vitamin B12 causes Pernicious Anaemia (megaloblastic anaemia with neurological symptoms).
2. Absorption of Vitamin B12 in the ileum requires 'Intrinsic Factor' secreted by parietal cells of the stomach.
3. Vitamin B9 (Folic acid) deficiency causes Megaloblastic Anaemia and neural tube defects (spina bifida) in foetuses.
4. Vitamin B12 is naturally synthesized by bacteria and found predominantly in animal-derived foods (meat, eggs, dairy).
qe: Which of the following vitamins contains Cobalt as its central metal atom?

q: किस विटामिन को 'सनशाइन विटामिन' भी कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह पराबैंगनी (UV-B) किरणों के संपर्क में आने पर मानव त्वचा में संश्लेषित होता है?
e:
Vitamin D (Calciferol) is synthesized in the skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol under UV-B sunlight (विटामिन D को सनशाइन विटामिन कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vitamin D2 is Ergocalciferol (plant/fungi source) and Vitamin D3 is Cholecalciferol (animal/skin source).
2. Deficiency causes Rickets in children (bowed legs, pigeon chest) and Osteomalacia in adults.
3. Vitamin D acts like a steroid hormone and regulates intestinal absorption of Calcium and Phosphorus.
4. Cod liver oil is a rich natural source of both Vitamin A and Vitamin D.
qe: Which vitamin is also known as the 'Sunshine Vitamin' because it is synthesized in human skin upon exposure to UV-B rays?

q: निम्नलिखित में से विटामिन और उसकी कमी से होने वाले रोग का कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e:
Vitamin E (Tocopherol) deficiency causes sterility/reproductive failure and haemolytic anaemia, NOT bleeding gums (मसूड़ों से रक्तस्राव विटामिन C की कमी से होने वाले स्कर्वी का लक्षण है, न कि विटामिन E का)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vitamin E is called the 'Anti-sterility vitamin' and 'Beauty vitamin'; it is a powerful lipid-soluble antioxidant.
2. Rich sources of Vitamin E include wheat germ oil, sunflower oil, almonds, and green leafy vegetables.
3. Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) is required for collagen synthesis; its deficiency causes Scurvy (spongy, bleeding gums, delayed wound healing).
4. Beriberi (Vitamin B1) exists as Dry Beriberi (nerve damage) and Wet Beriberi (cardiovascular oedema).
qe: Which of the following pairs of Vitamin and its Deficiency Disease is NOT correctly matched?

q:
विटामिन K के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: विटामिन K1 (फाइलोक्विनोन) मुख्यतः हरी पत्तेदार सब्जियों से प्राप्त होता है, जबकि विटामिन K2 (मेनाक्विनोन) आंतों के जीवाणुओं द्वारा संश्लेषित होता है।
कथन II: विटामिन K यकृत में रक्त स्कंदन कारकों II, VII, IX और X के गामा-कार्बोक्सिलेशन के लिए आवश्यक है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are completely accurate (दोनों कथन पूर्णतः सत्य हैं): Vitamin K1 comes from leafy greens, K2 is produced by gut flora (E. coli), and Vitamin K activates clotting factors II (prothrombin), VII, IX, and X.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vitamin K3 (Menadione) is a synthetic water-soluble form.
2. Warfarin (an anticoagulant) works by antagonizing Vitamin K epoxide reductase.
3. Newborn babies are routinely given a Vitamin K injection at birth to prevent Haemorrhagic Disease of the Newborn (HDN).
4. Calcium ions (Ca²⁺) and Fibrinogen (Factor I) are also indispensable for blood coagulation.
qe:
Consider the following two statements about Vitamin K:
Statement I: Vitamin K1 (Phylloquinone) is primarily obtained from green leafy vegetables, while Vitamin K2 (Menaquinone) is synthesized by intestinal bacteria.
Statement II: Vitamin K is essential for the gamma-carboxylation of clotting factors II, VII, IX, and X in the liver.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: बिना पूरक आहार के लंबे समय तक अत्यधिक पॉलिश किए गए सफेद चावल का मुख्य भोजन के रूप में सेवन करने से सामान्यतः किस विटामिन की कमी हो जाती है?
e:
Polishing removes the rice bran (outer pericarp/aleurone layer) which is rich in Vitamin B1 (Thiamine), leading to Beriberi (चावल की पॉलिशिंग से ऊपरी परत में मौजूद विटामिन B1 नष्ट हो जाता है, जिससे बेरी-बेरी होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Christiaan Eijkman won the 1929 Nobel Prize for discovering the antineuritic vitamin (B1) through polished rice studies in chickens.
2. Parboiled rice retains more Vitamin B1 than raw polished white rice.
3. Chronic alcoholism also causes severe Thiamine deficiency, leading to Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome.
4. Vitamin B7 (Biotin) deficiency can be induced by eating excessive raw egg whites, which contain the protein Avidin that binds biotin.
qe: Prolonged consumption of heavily polished white rice as a staple diet without supplementation most commonly causes deficiency of which vitamin?

q: किस विटामिन को रासायनिक रूप से एस्कॉर्बिक अम्ल कहा जाता है और जो मानव आंत में आयरन (लौह) के अवशोषण को बढ़ाता है?
e:
Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) reduces ferric iron (Fe³⁺) to the more absorbable ferrous form (Fe²⁺) in the gut (विटामिन C को एस्कॉर्बिक अम्ल कहा जाता है और यह आयरन के अवशोषण में सहायक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Richest natural sources of Vitamin C: Amla (Indian gooseberry), guava, citrus fruits (lemon, orange), and bell peppers.
2. Humans, guinea pigs, and primates cannot synthesize Vitamin C due to the absence of the enzyme L-gulonolactone oxidase.
3. Vitamin C is a potent water-soluble antioxidant and boosts immunity by supporting leucocyte function.
4. Milk and eggs contain virtually zero Vitamin C.
qe: Which vitamin is chemically known as Ascorbic Acid and enhances the absorption of non-haem iron in the human intestine?

q: कौन-सा B-कॉम्प्लेक्स विटामिन कोएंजाइम A (CoA) का संरचनात्मक घटक है, जो वसा अम्ल उपापचय और क्रेब्स चक्र के लिए आवश्यक है?
e:
Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic acid) is a mandatory precursor for synthesizing Coenzyme A (CoA) (विटामिन B5 या पैंटोथेनिक अम्ल कोएंजाइम A का प्रमुख घटक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) forms coenzymes FMN and FAD; Vitamin B3 (Niacin) forms NAD⁺ and NADP⁺.
2. Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) forms TPP (Thiamine Pyrophosphate); Vitamin B6 forms PLP (Pyridoxal Phosphate).
3. The word 'Pantothenic' comes from Greek 'pantos' (everywhere) because it is widely distributed in foods.
4. Deficiency of B5 causes 'Burning Feet Syndrome' (paraesthesia in feet).
qe: Which B-complex vitamin is a structural component of Coenzyme A (CoA), essential for fatty acid metabolism and the Krebs cycle?

q: विकासशील भ्रूण में न्यूरल ट्यूब दोष (जैसे स्पाइना बिफिडा) को रोकने के लिए प्रारंभिक गर्भावस्था के दौरान किस विटामिन के पूरक की विशेष रूप से सिफारिश की जाती है?
e:
Vitamin B9 (Folic acid / Folate) is crucial for DNA synthesis and rapid cell division; its deficiency in early pregnancy causes neural tube defects (गर्भावस्था में फोलिक अम्ल/विटामिन B9 की कमी से भ्रूण में न्यूरल ट्यूब दोष हो सकता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Both Vitamin B9 and Vitamin B12 deficiency cause Megaloblastic Anaemia (large immature RBCs).
2. Under India's 'Anaemia Mukt Bharat' programme, Iron and Folic Acid (IFA) tablets are distributed to pregnant women and adolescents.
3. Rich dietary sources of folate include spinach, lentils, chickpeas, and fortified cereals.
4. Folic acid is named after Latin 'folium' (leaf) because it was first isolated from spinach leaves.
qe: Supplementation of which vitamin is specifically recommended during early pregnancy to prevent neural tube defects (such as spina bifida) in the developing foetus?

q: लाल रक्त कणिकाओं में हीमोग्लोबिन के संश्लेषण के लिए कौन-सा खनिज आवश्यक है, जिसकी कमी से एनीमिया (रक्ताल्पता) होता है?
e:
Iron (Fe) is the core metal in the haem group of haemoglobin that binds oxygen; its deficiency causes iron-deficiency (microcytic hypochromic) anaemia (आयरन हीमोग्लोबिन का प्रमुख घटक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Normal haemoglobin level: ~13–17 g/dL in adult males and ~12–15 g/dL in adult females.
2. Iron is stored in the liver, spleen, and bone marrow as Ferritin and transported in blood by Transferrin.
3. Rich sources: Spinach, jaggery (गुड़), liver, red meat, legumes, and dates.
4. Chlorophyll contains Magnesium (Mg), whereas Haemoglobin contains Iron (Fe) and Haemocyanin (in molluscs/arthropods) contains Copper (Cu).
qe: Which mineral is essential for the synthesis of haemoglobin in red blood cells, and whose deficiency causes microcytic hypochromic anaemia?

q:
क्वाशिओरकोर और मरास्मस की तुलना करते हुए निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: क्वाशिओरकोर मुख्यतः पर्याप्त कैलोरी के साथ गंभीर प्रोटीन की कमी से होता है, जिसमें एडिमा (सूजन) और पेट बाहर निकलना देखा जाता है।
कथन II: मरास्मस प्रोटीन और कैलोरी दोनों की संयुक्त कमी से होता है, जिसमें बिना सूजन के गंभीर मांसपेशीय क्षय होता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements accurately distinguish the two major forms of Protein-Energy Malnutrition (PEM) (दोनों कथन प्रोटीन-ऊर्जा कुपोषण के दोनों रूपों को सही रूप से दर्शाते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Kwashiorkor typically affects children aged 1–5 years after weaning; features include 'moon face', oedema, and 'flag sign' (discoloured hair).
2. Marasmus typically affects infants under 1 year; features include sunken eyes, wrinkled skin ('old man's face'), and extreme thinness.
3. Proteins provide ~4 kcal/g, Carbohydrates ~4 kcal/g, and Fats ~9 kcal/g.
4. Essential amino acids (9 in adults, e.g., Leucine, Lysine, Tryptophan) cannot be synthesized by the human body and must come from diet.
qe:
Consider the following statements comparing Kwashiorkor and Marasmus:
Statement I: Kwashiorkor is primarily caused by severe protein deficiency with relatively adequate calories, characterized by oedema and a pot belly.
Statement II: Marasmus is caused by combined deficiency of both proteins and calories, characterized by severe muscle wasting without oedema.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: पेयजल के माध्यम से किस तत्व के अत्यधिक सेवन से दंत एवं अस्थि फ्लोरोसिस (दाँतों का चितकबरा होना और हड्डियों की विकृति) होता है?
e:
Excess fluoride (Fluorine, >1.5 mg/L in drinking water) causes dental fluorosis (mottled enamel) and skeletal fluorosis ('knock-knee' syndrome) (पेयजल में फ्लोराइड की अधिकता से फ्लोरोसिस होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Trace amounts of fluoride (~0.7–1.0 mg/L) actually protect tooth enamel against dental caries (cavities).
2. Excess Arsenic in groundwater causes Blackfoot disease and skin keratosis; excess Nitrate causes Blue Baby Syndrome (Methaemoglobinaemia).
3. Excess Mercury causes Minamata disease; excess Cadmium causes Itai-Itai disease.
4. Enamel is the hardest substance in the human body, made mainly of Hydroxyapatite (calcium phosphate).
qe: Excessive intake of which element through drinking water causes Dental and Skeletal Fluorosis (mottling of teeth and bone deformities)?

q: खनिज विद्युत-अपघट्यों का कौन-सा युग्म मुख्य रूप से Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase पंप के माध्यम से तंत्रिका आवेगों (action potentials) के निर्माण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
e:
Sodium (Na⁺, principal extracellular cation) and Potassium (K⁺, principal intracellular cation) drive nerve impulse conduction and osmotic balance (सोडियम और पोटैशियम तंत्रिका आवेग संचरण के लिए मुख्य रूप से उत्तरदायी हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Na⁺/K⁺ pump actively transports 3 Na⁺ ions out of the cell and 2 K⁺ ions into the cell using 1 ATP.
2. Excess dietary sodium contributes to hypertension (high blood pressure); WHO recommends <5 g salt/day.
3. Potassium deficiency (Hypokalaemia) causes muscle weakness and cardiac arrhythmias.
4. Calcium (Ca²⁺) is essential for muscle contraction (binding to troponin), neurotransmitter release, and blood clotting.
qe: Which pair of mineral electrolytes is primarily responsible for generating nerve impulses (action potentials) via the Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase pump?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कार्बोहाइड्रेट एक अन-अपचायक डाइसैकेराइड (non-reducing disaccharide) है जिसे सामान्यतः टेबल शुगर कहा जाता है?
e:
Sucrose (Glucose + Fructose linked via α-1,2-glycosidic bond) has no free aldehyde/ketone group, making it a non-reducing disaccharide (सुक्रोज एक अन-अपचायक डाइसैकेराइड है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Maltose = Glucose + Glucose (malt sugar); Lactose = Glucose + Galactose (milk sugar) — both are reducing sugars.
2. Fructose is the sweetest naturally occurring sugar (fruit sugar).
3. Glycogen is the storage polysaccharide in animals (stored in liver and skeletal muscles), often called 'animal starch'.
4. Cellulose (β-1,4-linked glucose) cannot be digested by humans due to lack of cellulase, serving as dietary fibre (roughage).
qe: Which of the following carbohydrates is a non-reducing disaccharide commonly known as table sugar?

q: किस सूक्ष्म खनिज (trace mineral) की कमी से घाव भरने में देरी होती है, स्वाद क्षमता घटती है, और बच्चों के दस्त में ORS के साथ इसका पूरक विशेष रूप से दिया जाता है?
e:
Zinc is a cofactor for >300 enzymes (including carbonic anhydrase and insulin storage) and WHO/UNICEF recommend 14-day Zinc supplementation with ORS for paediatric diarrhoea (जस्ता घाव भरने, प्रतिरक्षा तथा बच्चों के दस्त के उपचार में अत्यंत उपयोगी है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Selenium is an antioxidant cofactor for Glutathione Peroxidase; its deficiency causes Keshan disease (cardiomyopathy).
2. Chromium enhances insulin sensitivity (Glucose Tolerance Factor).
3. Iodine is required for thyroid hormones (T3, T4); its deficiency causes Goitre and Cretinism.
4. Copper deficiency causes Menkes disease; excess copper accumulation causes Wilson's disease.
qe: Deficiency of which trace mineral impairs wound healing, reduces taste acuity (hypogeusia), and is specifically supplemented alongside ORS in childhood diarrhoea?

q: निम्नलिखित वृहद पोषक तत्वों (macronutrients) में से किसके पूर्ण ऑक्सीकरण से मानव शरीर में प्रति ग्राम सर्वाधिक ऊर्जा प्राप्त होती है?
e:
Fats (Lipids) yield approximately 9 kcal/g (37 kJ/g), more than double that of carbohydrates (4 kcal/g) and proteins (4 kcal/g) (वसा से प्रति ग्राम लगभग 9 किलो कैलोरी ऊर्जा मिलती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Essential fatty acids that humans cannot synthesize are Linoleic acid (omega-6) and Alpha-linolenic acid (omega-3).
2. Unsaturated fats (with C=C double bonds, e.g., olive/mustard oil) are liquid at room temperature and healthier than saturated/trans fats.
3. Trans fats (formed by partial hydrogenation of vegetable oils) raise LDL ('bad' cholesterol) and lower HDL ('good' cholesterol).
4. Body Mass Index (BMI) = Weight (kg) ÷ [Height (m)]²; normal adult range is 18.5–24.9 kg/m².
qe: Among the following macronutrients, which yields the highest amount of physiological energy per gram upon complete oxidation in the human body?

q:
सूची-I (खनिज) को सूची-II (प्रमुख शारीरिक कार्य) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. फॉस्फोरस
2. आयोडीन
3. सेलेनियम
4. कैल्शियम
सूची-II:
(a) थायरॉइड हार्मोन संश्लेषण
(b) एंटीऑक्सीडेंट एंजाइम ग्लूटाथियोन परऑक्सीडेज
(c) ATP, DNA तथा अस्थि हाइड्रॉक्सीएपेटाइट
(d) रक्त का थक्का जमना और पेशी संकुचन
e:
Phosphorus forms ATP, nucleic acids (DNA/RNA), and bone mineral; Iodine forms thyroxine; Selenium is integral to glutathione peroxidase; Calcium regulates clotting and muscle contraction (1-c, 2-a, 3-b, 4-d)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Approximately 85% of the body's phosphorus and 99% of its calcium are stored in bones and teeth.
2. Calcium-to-Phosphorus ratio in bones is roughly 2 : 1.
3. Iodized salt contains Potassium Iodate (KIO₃) to prevent iodine deficiency disorders (IDD).
4. Parathormone (PTH) raises blood calcium, while Calcitonin lowers blood calcium.
qe:
Match List-I (Mineral) with List-II (Primary Physiological Role) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Phosphorus
2. Iodine
3. Selenium
4. Calcium
List-II:
(a) Thyroid hormone synthesis
(b) Antioxidant enzyme glutathione peroxidase
(c) ATP, DNA, and bone hydroxyapatite
(d) Blood clotting and muscle contraction

q: मानव में क्षय रोग (तपेदिक / TB) का कारक जीवाणु कौन-सा है?
e:
Tuberculosis is caused by the rod-shaped acid-fast bacillus Mycobacterium tuberculosis, discovered by Robert Koch in 1882 (क्षय रोग माइकोबैक्टीरियम ट्यूबरकुलोसिस जीवाणु से होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. BCG (Bacillus Calmette-Guérin) vaccine protects infants against severe TB; Mantoux (Tuberculin) skin test screens for TB infection.
2. DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment, Short-course) is the standard TB treatment strategy using rifampicin, isoniazid, pyrazinamide, and ethambutol.
3. Salmonella typhi causes Typhoid (diagnosed by Widal test); Vibrio cholerae causes Cholera; Clostridium tetani causes Tetanus (Lockjaw).
4. World TB Day is observed on 24 March every year.
qe: Which bacterium is the causative agent of Tuberculosis (TB) in humans?

q:
सूची-I (रोग) को सूची-II (वाहक) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. मलेरिया
2. डेंगू
3. कालाजार
4. निद्रा रोग
सूची-II:
(a) बालू मक्खी (सैंडफ्लाई)
(b) सी-सी मक्खी
(c) मादा एनाफिलीज मच्छर
(d) मादा एडीज एजिप्टी मच्छर
e:
Malaria is spread by Female Anopheles, Dengue by Female Aedes aegypti, Kala-azar by Sandfly (Phlebotomus), and African Sleeping Sickness by Tsetse fly (1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Causative pathogens: Malaria — Plasmodium (P. falciparum is most lethal); Dengue — Flavivirus (RNA virus); Kala-azar — Leishmania donovani; Sleeping Sickness — Trypanosoma brucei.
2. Aedes aegypti also transmits Chikungunya, Zika, and Yellow Fever ('Tiger mosquito', bites during daytime).
3. Female Culex mosquito transmits Filariasis (Elephantiasis, caused by Wuchereria bancrofti) and Japanese Encephalitis.
4. Ronald Ross received the 1902 Nobel Prize for discovering the malaria transmission cycle in Anopheles mosquitoes.
qe:
Match List-I (Disease) with List-II (Vector) and choose the correct code:
List-I:
1. Malaria
2. Dengue
3. Kala-azar (Visceral Leishmaniasis)
4. Sleeping Sickness
List-II:
(a) Sandfly (Phlebotomus)
(b) Tsetse fly (Glossina)
(c) Female Anopheles mosquito
(d) Female Aedes aegypti mosquito

q: विडाल परीक्षण (Widal Test) किस जीवाणुजनित रोग की पहचान के लिए व्यापक रूप से किया जाने वाला सीरम परीक्षण है?
e:
The Widal test detects agglutinating antibodies against O and H antigens of Salmonella enterica serotype Typhi, which causes Typhoid (विडाल परीक्षण टाइफाइड या मियादी बुखार की जाँच के लिए किया जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) is the screening test for HIV/AIDS; Western Blot is the confirmatory test.
2. Mantoux test is used for TB; Schick test for Diphtheria; Dick test for Scarlet fever; VDRL test for Syphilis.
3. Typhoid is transmitted through contaminated food and water (faecal-oral route) and primarily affects the small intestine (Peyer's patches).
4. 'Typhoid Mary' (Mary Mallon) was a famous asymptomatic carrier of Typhoid.
qe: The Widal Test is a widely used serological diagnostic test for detecting which bacterial disease?

q: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा रोग विषाणु (वायरस) के बजाय एक प्रोटोजोआ परजीवी के कारण होता है?
e:
Amoebiasis (Amoebic dysentery) is caused by the protozoan Entamoeba histolytica, whereas Polio, Rabies, and Hepatitis B are viral diseases (अमीबियासिस प्रोटोजोआ एंटअमीबा हिस्टोलिटिका से होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Polio is caused by Poliovirus (RNA virus); Salk developed IPV (inactivated) and Sabin developed OPV (oral live-attenuated).
2. Rabies (Hydrophobia) is caused by Lyssavirus (Rhabdovirus); Louis Pasteur developed the first rabies vaccine.
3. Hepatitis B is the only major Hepatitis virus with a DNA genome (A, C, D, E are RNA viruses); A and E spread via contaminated food/water, while B, C, D spread via blood/body fluids.
4. Entamoeba histolytica infects the large intestine and spreads via houseflies and contaminated water.
qe: Which of the following diseases is caused by a Protozoan parasite rather than a Virus?

q: HIV/AIDS के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: HIV is a retrovirus containing RNA as its genetic material.
HIV primarily destroys helper T-lymphocytes (CD4⁺ cells).
HIV is commonly transmitted through mosquito bites and casual contact.
Reverse transcriptase converts viral RNA into DNA inside host cells.
e:
HIV is NOT transmitted by mosquito bites, shaking hands, or sharing food/utensils (HIV मच्छर के काटने या सामान्य स्पर्श से नहीं फैलता); it spreads via unprotected sexual contact, contaminated blood/needles, and mother-to-child transmission.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. AIDS stands for Acquired Immuno-Deficiency Syndrome; World AIDS Day is observed on 1 December.
2. Antiretroviral Therapy (ART), including drugs like Zidovudine (AZT), suppresses viral replication.
3. HIV belongs to the Lentivirus genus of the Retroviridae family.
4. National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) oversees HIV prevention and treatment in India.
qe: Which of the following statements about HIV/AIDS is NOT correct?
oe: HIV is a retrovirus containing RNA as its genetic material.
HIV primarily destroys helper T-lymphocytes (CD4⁺ cells).
HIV is commonly transmitted through mosquito bites and casual contact.
Reverse transcriptase converts viral RNA into DNA inside host cells.

q: हीमोफीलिया और लाल-हरा वर्णांधता मानव में किस प्रकार की आनुवंशिक वंशागति के प्रमुख उदाहरण हैं?
e:
Both Haemophilia ('Bleeder's disease' / 'Royal disease') and Red-Green Colour Blindness are X-linked recessive disorders (दोनों X-सहलग्न अप्रभावी आनुवंशिक विकार हैं), hence they affect males far more frequently than females.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Haemophilia A is due to deficiency of Clotting Factor VIII; Haemophilia B (Christmas disease) is due to Factor IX deficiency.
2. Females have two X chromosomes (XX) and are usually asymptomatic carriers unless both X chromosomes carry the defective allele.
3. Sickle Cell Anaemia, Thalassaemia, and Phenylketonuria (PKU) are Autosomal Recessive disorders.
4. Colour blindness is tested using Ishihara colour plates.
qe: Haemophilia and Red-Green Colour Blindness are classic examples of which type of genetic inheritance in humans?

q: मानव में डाउन सिंड्रोम (Down Syndrome) किस विशिष्ट गुणसूत्रीय असामान्यता के कारण होता है?
o: Monosomy of the X chromosome (45, XO)
Presence of an extra X chromosome in males (47, XXY)
Deletion on the short arm of chromosome 5
e:
Down Syndrome is caused by Trisomy 21 (three copies of chromosome 21 instead of two, total 47 chromosomes) due to non-disjunction during meiosis (डाउन सिंड्रोम 21वें गुणसूत्र की त्रिसूत्रता के कारण होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Turner Syndrome = 45, XO (monosomy of X in females — sterile, webbed neck).
2. Klinefelter Syndrome = 47, XXY (extra X in males — gynaecomastia, sterile).
3. Cri-du-chat Syndrome = deletion on short arm of chromosome 5 (5p-).
4. Edward Syndrome = Trisomy 18; Patau Syndrome = Trisomy 13.
qe: Down Syndrome in humans is caused by which specific chromosomal abnormality?
oe: Monosomy of the X chromosome (45, XO)
Presence of an extra X chromosome in males (47, XXY)
Deletion on the short arm of chromosome 5

q: शिशुओं को दिया जाने वाला DPT (ट्रिपल एंटीजन) टीका किन तीन जीवाणुजनित रोगों से प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करता है?
e:
DPT protects against Diphtheria (Corynebacterium diphtheriae), Pertussis / Whooping Cough (Bordetella pertussis), and Tetanus (Clostridium tetani) (DPT टीका डिप्थीरिया, काली खाँसी और टिटनेस से बचाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Pentavalent vaccine under India's Universal Immunization Programme (UIP) covers 5 diseases: DPT + Hepatitis B + Hib (Haemophilus influenzae type b).
2. MMR vaccine protects against Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (all viral diseases).
3. Diphtheria and Tetanus components are toxoids (inactivated toxins), while Pertussis is killed whole-cell or acellular bacteria.
4. India was officially certified Polio-free by WHO on 27 March 2014.
qe: The DPT (triple antigen) vaccine administered to infants provides immunity against which three bacterial diseases?

q: सिकल सेल एनीमिया एक आनुवंशिक विकार है जो β-ग्लोबिन जीन (गुणसूत्र 11) में एकल बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन के कारण होता है, जिसमें 6वें स्थान पर किस अमीनो अम्ल का प्रतिस्थापन होता है?
o: ग्लूटामिक अम्ल के स्थान पर वैलीन
वैलीन के स्थान पर ग्लूटामिक अम्ल
e:
In Sickle Cell Anaemia, codon GAG mutates to GUG, replacing hydrophilic Glutamic acid (Glu) with hydrophobic Valine (Val) at position 6 of the β-globin chain (ग्लूटामिक अम्ल के स्थान पर वैलीन आ जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Under low oxygen tension, abnormal HbS polymerizes, turning biconcave RBCs into rigid sickle shapes.
2. Heterozygous carriers (HbA/HbS) enjoy natural resistance against severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria (balanced polymorphism).
3. India launched the National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission (2023) to eliminate the disease by 2047.
4. It is an Autosomal Recessive disorder (अलिंगसूत्री अप्रभावी विकार).
qe: Sickle Cell Anaemia is a genetic disorder caused by a single point mutation in the β-globin gene (chromosome 11), substituting which amino acid at the 6th position?

q: मानव में दाद (रिंगवर्म) और एथलीट फुट किस सूक्ष्मजीव समूह के कारण होने वाले संक्रामक त्वचा रोग हैं?
e:
Ringworm and Athlete's Foot are superficial fungal infections caused by dermatophyte fungi belonging to genera Microsporum, Trichophyton, and Epidermophyton (दाद और एथलीट फुट कवकजनित रोग हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Despite the name 'Ringworm', it is NOT caused by a worm—it forms ring-shaped scaly lesions on skin/scalp/nails.
2. Other fungal diseases in humans: Candidiasis (Candida albicans), Aspergillosis, and Mucormycosis ('Black Fungus').
3. Helminthic (worm) diseases include Ascariasis (Ascaris lumbricoides), Filariasis (Wuchereria), and Taeniasis (Taenia solium).
4. Warm, moist skin folds (groin, between toes) favour fungal growth.
qe: Ringworm (Tinea) and Athlete's Foot in humans are infectious skin diseases caused by which group of microorganisms?

q: कुष्ठ रोग (हैनसेन रोग), जो मुख्य रूप से परिधीय तंत्रिकाओं और त्वचा को प्रभावित करता है, किसके कारण होता है?
e:
Leprosy is a chronic bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium leprae, discovered by Gerhard Armauer Hansen in 1873 (कुष्ठ रोग माइकोबैक्टीरियम लेप्री जीवाणु के कारण होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Leprosy is completely curable through Multi-Drug Therapy (MDT: Dapsone, Rifampicin, and Clofazimine).
2. Treponema pallidum causes Syphilis; Yersinia pestis causes Plague (transmitted by rat flea Xenopsylla cheopis).
3. Bordetella pertussis causes Whooping Cough (Pertussis).
4. National Leprosy Eradication Programme (NLEP) aims to eliminate leprosy across India.
qe: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease), which primarily affects the peripheral nerves and skin, is caused by:

q: ह्यूमन पैपिलोमावायरस (HPV, विशेषकर टाइप 16 और 18) के दीर्घकालिक संक्रमण से महिलाओं में मुख्य रूप से कौन-सा कैंसर होता है?
e:
High-risk HPV strains (16 and 18) account for over 70% of Cervical Cancer cases worldwide (HPV संक्रमण महिलाओं में गर्भाशय ग्रीवा कैंसर का प्रमुख कारण है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. India's first indigenous quadrivalent HPV vaccine is 'CERVAVAC' (developed by Serum Institute of India with DBT).
2. Pap smear test is used for early screening of cervical cancer.
3. Oncogenes promote uncontrolled cell division, whereas tumour suppressor genes (like p53, BRCA1/2) inhibit it.
4. Metastasis is the spread of malignant cancer cells to distant organs via blood or lymph.
qe: Persistent infection with high-risk strains of Human Papillomavirus (HPV, especially types 16 and 18) is the primary cause of which cancer in women?

q:
मलेरिया के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: मादा एनाफिलीज मच्छर के काटने से मानव में प्रेषित होने वाली प्लाज्मोडियम की संक्रामक अवस्था स्पोरोज़ोइट (Sporozoite) है।
कथन II: मलेरिया में बार-बार कंपकंपी और तेज बुखार के लिए उत्तरदायी विषाक्त पदार्थ हीमोज़ोइन (Haemozoin) है, जो संक्रमित RBC के फटने पर मुक्त होता है।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are completely accurate (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं): Sporozoites enter human blood via mosquito saliva, multiply in the liver, then infect RBCs; RBC rupture releases Haemozoin causing periodic fever chills.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Antimalarial drugs: Quinine (from bark of Cinchona tree), Chloroquine, and Artemisinin-based Combination Therapy (ACT).
2. Plasmodium completes its sexual cycle in the mosquito (primary/definitive host) and asexual cycle in humans (secondary host).
3. Gambusia fish (larvivorous fish) is introduced in ponds to control mosquito larvae biologically.
4. RTS,S/AS01 (Mosquirix) and R21/Matrix-M are WHO-recommended malaria vaccines.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Malaria:
Statement I: The infective stage of Plasmodium transmitted to humans by the bite of a female Anopheles mosquito is the Sporozoite.
Statement II: The toxic substance responsible for recurring chills and high fever in malaria is Haemozoin, released upon rupture of infected RBCs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: किस अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथि को 'मास्टर ग्रंथि' कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह अधिकांश अन्य अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथियों के स्राव को नियंत्रित करती है?
e:
The Pituitary gland (Hypophysis), situated in the sella turcica of the sphenoid bone at the base of the brain, is called the 'Master Gland' (पीयूष ग्रंथि को मास्टर ग्रंथि कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The Hypothalamus is called the 'Master of the Master Gland' (Super-master) as it controls the pituitary via releasing/inhibiting hormones.
2. Anterior pituitary secretes GH, TSH, ACTH, FSH, LH, and Prolactin.
3. Posterior pituitary stores and releases Oxytocin (birth/milk-ejection hormone) and ADH/Vasopressin (synthesized in hypothalamus).
4. Excess Growth Hormone (GH) causes Gigantism in children and Acromegaly in adults; deficiency in children causes Dwarfism.
qe: Which endocrine gland is known as the 'Master Gland' because it regulates the secretion of most other endocrine glands?

q: इंसुलिन, जो कोशिकीय ग्लूकोज ग्रहण और ग्लाइकोजेनेसिस को बढ़ावा देकर रक्त शर्करा के स्तर को कम करता है, अग्न्याशय के लैंगरहैंस की द्वीपिकाओं की किन कोशिकाओं द्वारा स्रावित होता है?
e:
Beta (β) cells of the Islets of Langerhans secrete Insulin (अग्न्याशय की बीटा कोशिकाएँ इंसुलिन स्रावित करती हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Alpha (α) cells secrete Glucagon (raises blood glucose via glycogenolysis); Delta (δ) cells secrete Somatostatin (inhibits both).
2. The pancreas is a 'mixed (heterocrine) gland'—its exocrine acinar cells secrete digestive pancreatic juice, while endocrine islets secrete hormones.
3. Deficiency or resistance to Insulin causes Diabetes Mellitus (hyperglycaemia, glycosuria).
4. Insulin is a peptide hormone containing 51 amino acids (A-chain: 21, B-chain: 30) linked by disulphide bridges, and contains Zinc in crystalline form.
qe: Insulin, which lowers blood glucose levels by promoting cellular glucose uptake and glycogenesis, is secreted by which cells of the Islets of Langerhans in the pancreas?

q: तनाव, भय या उत्तेजना के समय स्रावित होने वाले किस हार्मोन को 'लड़ो या भागो' (आपातकालीन) हार्मोन कहा जाता है?
e:
Adrenaline (Epinephrine), along with Noradrenaline, is secreted by the Adrenal Medulla during emergencies, increasing heart rate, blood pressure, and blood glucose (एड्रेनालिन को आपातकालीन या 'लड़ो या भागो' हार्मोन कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Adrenal glands are located atop the kidneys ('suprarenal glands'); their cortex secretes Cortisol (stress hormone), Aldosterone (mineralocorticoid), and androgens.
2. Hypersecretion of Cortisol causes Cushing's Syndrome (moon face, buffalo hump); hyposecretion of adrenal cortex causes Addison's Disease (bronze skin pigmentation).
3. Melatonin is secreted by the Pineal gland and regulates the sleep-wake circadian rhythm.
4. Oxytocin stimulates uterine contractions during childbirth and milk ejection during lactation.
qe: Which hormone is known as the 'Fight-or-Flight' (Emergency) hormone, secreted during stress, fear, or excitement?

q:
सूची-I (अंतःस्रावी विकार) को सूची-II (संबंधित हार्मोन/ग्रंथि) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. डायबिटीज इन्सिपिडस (उदकमेह)
2. एक्रोमेगाली (अतिकायता)
3. सामान्य घेंघा (गॉयटर)
4. टिटैनी
सूची-II:
(a) थायरॉइड (थायरॉक्सिन की कमी)
(b) पैराथायरॉइड (PTH की कमी)
(c) पश्च पीयूष (ADH की कमी)
(d) अग्र पीयूष (वयस्कों में अधिक GH)
e:
Diabetes Insipidus is due to ADH/Vasopressin deficiency (copious dilute urine without glucose); Acromegaly is adult GH excess; Simple Goitre is iodine/thyroxine deficiency; Hypocalcaemic Tetany is PTH deficiency (1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Unlike Diabetes Mellitus (insulin deficiency, sweet urine), Diabetes Insipidus has normal blood glucose and dilute, tasteless urine.
2. Hyperthyroidism causes Exophthalmic Goitre (Graves' disease — bulging eyes, weight loss, high BMR).
3. Hypothyroidism in children causes Cretinism (stunted physical & mental growth); in adults it causes Myxoedema.
4. Thyroid is the largest endocrine gland in the human body (butterfly-shaped, located in the neck).
qe:
Match List-I (Endocrine Disorder) with List-II (Associated Hormone/Gland) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Diabetes Insipidus
2. Acromegaly
3. Simple Goitre
4. Tetany
List-II:
(a) Thyroid (Thyroxine deficiency)
(b) Parathyroid (PTH deficiency)
(c) Posterior Pituitary (ADH deficiency)
(d) Anterior Pituitary (Excess GH in adults)

q: मानव शरीर की कौन-सी ग्रंथि मेलाटोनिन हार्मोन का स्राव करके दैनिक जैविक चक्र (नींद-जागने के चक्र) को नियंत्रित करती है?
e:
The Pineal gland (epiphysis cerebri), located in the dorsal forebrain, secretes Melatonin in response to darkness, acting as the body's 'biological clock' (पीनियल ग्रंथि मेलाटोनिन स्रावित कर जैविक घड़ी का कार्य करती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Melatonin secretion peaks at night and is suppressed by blue light exposure.
2. The Thymus gland secretes Thymosin, which promotes T-lymphocyte maturation; thymus gradually degenerates (atrophies) in old age, weakening immunity.
3. The Pineal gland is often called the 'Third Eye' in lower vertebrates.
4. Pituitary is the smallest major endocrine gland (~0.5 g), while Thyroid is the largest endocrine gland (~25 g) and Liver is the largest overall gland.
qe: Which gland in the human body regulates the circadian rhythm (sleep-wake cycle) by secreting the hormone Melatonin?

q: थाइमस ग्रंथि द्वारा स्रावित कौन-सा हार्मोन कोशिका-मध्यस्थ प्रतिरक्षा के लिए T-लिम्फोसाइट्स के विभेदन और परिपक्वता में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है?
e:
Thymosin is a peptide hormone secreted by the Thymus gland (located behind the sternum, between the lungs) that matures T-cells (थाइमोसिन T-लिम्फोसाइट्स के परिपक्वन में सहायक है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Because the thymus shrinks with age, elderly individuals have reduced thymosin levels and weaker cell-mediated immunity.
2. Calcitonin (from parafollicular C-cells of thyroid) lowers blood Ca²⁺ levels.
3. Aldosterone (from adrenal cortex) promotes Na⁺ and water reabsorption and K⁺ excretion in renal tubules.
4. Prolactin (from anterior pituitary) stimulates milk synthesis in mammary glands, while Oxytocin causes milk ejection.
qe: Which hormone secreted by the Thymus gland plays a crucial role in the differentiation and maturation of T-lymphocytes for cell-mediated immunity?

q: मानव में रक्त कैल्शियम स्तर के नियमन के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही नहीं है?
o: Parathormone (PTH) increases blood calcium levels by stimulating bone resorption.
Calcitonin decreases blood calcium levels by inhibiting osteoclast activity.
Active Vitamin D (Calcitriol) increases intestinal absorption of calcium.
Parathormone and Calcitonin act synergistically to lower blood calcium.
e:
Parathormone (PTH, hypercalcaemic) and Calcitonin (hypocalcaemic) act ANTAGONISTICALLY (विपरीत रूप से), NOT synergistically, to maintain blood Ca²⁺ homeostasis (दोनों हार्मोन एक-दूसरे के विपरीत कार्य करते हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Similarly, Insulin and Glucagon are antagonistic hormones regulating blood glucose.
2. There are 4 Parathyroid glands embedded on the posterior surface of the thyroid gland.
3. Hyperparathyroidism causes bone demineralization (osteoporosis) and kidney stones.
4. Vitamin D is activated sequentially in the liver and kidneys to form Calcitriol (1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol).
qe: Which of the following statements regarding the regulation of blood calcium levels in humans is NOT correct?
oe: Parathormone (PTH) increases blood calcium levels by stimulating bone resorption.
Calcitonin decreases blood calcium levels by inhibiting osteoclast activity.
Active Vitamin D (Calcitriol) increases intestinal absorption of calcium.
Parathormone and Calcitonin act synergistically to lower blood calcium.

q: मानव स्त्रियों में, मुख्यतः कॉर्पस ल्यूटियम द्वारा स्रावित कौन-सा हार्मोन गर्भावस्था के दौरान गर्भाशय की अंतःस्तर (एंडोमेट्रियम) को बनाए रखता है?
e:
Progesterone is called the 'Pregnancy Hormone' because it maintains the thickened uterine endometrium and prevents uterine contractions during pregnancy (प्रोजेस्टेरोन को गर्भावस्था हार्मोन कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Oestrogen (from ovarian follicles) develops female secondary sexual characteristics and repairs the endometrium after menstruation.
2. A surge in Luteinizing Hormone (LH surge) around day 14 of the menstrual cycle triggers ovulation.
3. hCG (human Chorionic Gonadotropin), secreted by the placenta, is detected in home pregnancy tests.
4. Testosterone is secreted by Leydig (interstitial) cells of the testes in males.
qe: In human females, which hormone secreted primarily by the Corpus Luteum maintains the endometrial lining of the uterus during pregnancy?

q: एडिसन रोग, जिसमें अत्यधिक थकान, निम्न रक्तचाप, हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया और त्वचा का कांस्य जैसा रंग देखा जाता है, किस संरचना के हार्मोनों के अल्पस्राव से होता है?
e:
Addison's Disease results from underproduction (hyposecretion) of adrenal cortical hormones—specifically Cortisol and Aldosterone (एडिसन रोग अधिवृक्क वल्कुट के हार्मोनों के अल्पस्राव से होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Conversely, hypersecretion of cortisol from the adrenal cortex causes Cushing's Syndrome.
2. Hypersecretion of aldosterone causes Conn's Syndrome (hypertension and hypokalaemia).
3. The adrenal cortex has three zones (outer to inner): Zona glomerulosa (aldosterone), Zona fasciculata (cortisol), and Zona reticularis (androgens).
4. Adrenal medulla is derived from neural crest cells and secretes catecholamines (adrenaline & noradrenaline).
qe: Addison's Disease, characterized by extreme fatigue, hypotension, hypoglycaemia, and bronze pigmentation of the skin, results from hyposecretion of hormones from which structure?

q: मानव लार में उपस्थित लार एमाइलेज (टायलिन) मुख में किस पोषक तत्व के रासायनिक पाचन की शुरुआत करता है?
e:
Salivary amylase (Ptyalin) hydrolyses ~30% of cooked starch into Maltose at an optimal slightly acidic pH of ~6.8 (टायलिन मुख में स्टार्च को माल्टोज में बदलता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Saliva also contains Lysozyme, an antibacterial enzyme that destroys bacterial cell walls.
2. Protein digestion begins in the stomach (by Pepsin at pH ~1.5–2.0); fat digestion mainly occurs in the small intestine (by Pancreatic Lipase).
3. Human saliva is secreted by three pairs of salivary glands: Parotid (largest), Submandibular, and Sublingual.
4. Mumps is a viral infection causing painful swelling of the Parotid salivary glands.
qe: Salivary amylase (Ptyalin) present in human saliva initiates the chemical digestion of which nutrient in the mouth?

q:
सूची-I (पाचक एंजाइम) को सूची-II (प्रमुख क्रियाधार) से सुमेलित कीजिए तथा सही कूट चुनिए:
सूची-I:
1. पेप्सिन
2. लाइपेज
3. रेनिन (काइमोसिन)
4. लैक्टेज
सूची-II:
(a) दुग्ध प्रोटीन (केसीन)
(b) दुग्ध शर्करा (लैक्टोज)
(c) प्रोटीन (आमाशय में)
(d) पायसीकृत वसा
e:
Pepsin digests proteins in the acidic stomach; Lipase breaks emulsified fats into fatty acids + glycerol; Rennin curdles milk protein casein in infants; Lactase breaks lactose into glucose + galactose (1-c, 2-d, 3-a, 4-b)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Do NOT confuse Rennin (digestive enzyme in infant stomach) with Renin (kidney enzyme from JGA that regulates blood pressure via RAAS).
2. Pepsinogen is activated into Pepsin by HCl secreted by gastric parietal (oxyntic) cells.
3. Trypsinogen (pancreatic juice) is activated into Trypsin by Enterokinase in the duodenum.
4. Sucrase breaks sucrose into glucose + fructose; Maltase breaks maltose into two glucose molecules.
qe:
Match List-I (Digestive Enzyme) with List-II (Primary Substrate) and select the correct code:
List-I:
1. Pepsin
2. Lipase
3. Rennin (Chymosin)
4. Lactase
List-II:
(a) Milk protein (Casein)
(b) Milk sugar (Lactose)
(c) Proteins (in stomach)
(d) Emulsified fats

q: मानव पाचन तंत्र में पित्त रस (Bile juice) के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सही है?
o: It is produced by the gall bladder and contains trypsin.
It is produced by the liver and contains no digestive enzymes.
It is produced by the pancreas and digests starch into maltose.
It is strongly acidic and activates pepsinogen in the stomach.
e:
Bile is synthesized by the liver, stored and concentrated in the gall bladder, is alkaline (pH ~7.8–8.6), and contains NO digestive enzymes (पित्त रस यकृत में बनता है, पित्ताशय में संचित होता है और इसमें कोई पाचक एंजाइम नहीं होता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bile salts (sodium glycocholate & taurocholate) emulsify large fat globules into tiny droplets, increasing surface area for lipase action.
2. Bile pigments Bilirubin and Biliverdin are breakdown products of haemoglobin; excess bilirubin in blood causes Jaundice (पीलिया).
3. Gallstones are most commonly made of crystallized cholesterol or calcium bilirubinate.
4. Complete digestion and maximum absorption of nutrients take place in the small intestine (jejunum and ileum via villi).
qe: Which of the following statements about Bile juice in the human digestive system is correct?
oe: It is produced by the gall bladder and contains trypsin.
It is produced by the liver and contains no digestive enzymes.
It is produced by the pancreas and digests starch into maltose.
It is strongly acidic and activates pepsinogen in the stomach.

q: कार्ल लैंडस्टीनर द्वारा खोजे गए ABO रक्त समूह प्रणाली में किस रक्त समूह के व्यक्तियों को 'सार्वत्रिक दाता' (Universal Donor) कहा जाता है?
e:
Blood group O⁻ (O negative) RBCs lack A, B, and Rh (D) antigens on their surface, so they do not trigger agglutination in recipients, making O⁻ the true Universal Donor (O⁻ सार्वत्रिक दाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Blood group AB⁺ is the 'Universal Recipient' because its plasma lacks anti-A, anti-B, and anti-Rh antibodies.
2. Rh factor was discovered by Landsteiner and Wiener (1940) in Rhesus monkeys (Macaca mulatta).
3. Erythroblastosis foetalis occurs when an Rh⁻ mother carries a second Rh⁺ foetus; prevented by anti-D (RhoGAM) injection after the first delivery.
4. Normal human blood pH is 7.35–7.45 (slightly alkaline); average adult blood volume is ~5 litres.
qe: In the ABO blood group system discovered by Karl Landsteiner, individuals with which blood group are known as 'Universal Donors' (for packed red blood cells)?

q: कौन-सा इम्युनोग्लोबुलिन (एंटीबॉडी) एकमात्र ऐसा वर्ग है जो मानव अपरा (placenta) को पार कर भ्रूण को प्राकृतिक निष्क्रिय प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान कर सकता है?
e:
IgG is the most abundant (~75–80%) and smallest monomeric antibody, and is the ONLY immunoglobulin capable of crossing the placenta (IgG एकमात्र एंटीबॉडी है जो प्लेसेंटा को पार कर सकती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. IgA is abundant in colostrum (mother's first yellow milk), saliva, and tears, giving passive mucosal immunity to newborns.
2. IgM is the largest antibody (pentamer) and the first antibody produced during a primary immune response.
3. IgE mediates allergic reactions (triggers mast cells to release histamine) and defends against parasitic worms.
4. Active immunity develops when the body makes its own antibodies (infection/vaccination); Passive immunity involves receiving pre-formed antibodies (colostrum, anti-venom, ATS).
qe: Which immunoglobulin (antibody) is the ONLY class that can cross the human placenta to provide natural passive immunity to the foetus?

q:
भारत सरकार द्वारा शुरू किए गए 'मिशन इंद्रधनुष' के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: इसे दिसंबर 2014 में 2 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों और गर्भवती महिलाओं के पूर्ण टीकाकरण के लिए शुरू किया गया था।
कथन II: सार्वभौमिक टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम (UIP) के अंतर्गत 12 टीका-निवार्य रोगों के विरुद्ध निःशुल्क टीके प्रदान किए जाते हैं।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are correct (दोनों कथन सही हैं): Mission Indradhanush (launched 25 Dec 2014) accelerates UIP, which covers 12 diseases—9 nationally (Diphtheria, Pertussis, Tetanus, Polio, Measles, Rubella, severe TB, Hepatitis B, Hib) plus Rotavirus, PCV, and JE in endemic areas.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Intensified Mission Indradhanush (IMI 5.0) used the U-WIN digital portal to track every pregnant woman and child's vaccination.
2. India's National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) targets eliminating TB in India ahead of the global 2030 SDG target (with Nikshay Poshan Yojana providing monthly nutritional support).
3. Swachh Bharat Mission (launched 2 October 2014) achieved Open Defecation Free (ODF) status in rural India in 2019; Phase II focuses on ODF Plus (solid & liquid waste management).
4. Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY provides ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
qe:
Consider the following statements regarding Mission Indradhanush launched by the Government of India:
Statement I: It was launched in December 2014 to achieve full immunization coverage for children under 2 years and pregnant women.
Statement II: Under the Universal Immunization Programme (UIP), vaccines are provided free of cost against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases (nationally/sub-nationally).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: मानव हृदय में कौन-सी संरचना प्राकृतिक 'पेसमेकर' (गति प्रेरक) के रूप में कार्य करती है जो लयबद्ध हृदय संकुचन प्रारंभ करती है?
e:
The Sinoatrial (SA) node, located in the upper right corner of the right atrium, generates action potentials (~70–75 beats/min) and is called the natural pacemaker (SA नोड हृदय का प्राकृतिक पेसमेकर है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Conduction pathway: SA node → AV node → Bundle of His → Purkinje fibres.
2. Normal adult resting blood pressure is 120/80 mmHg (Systolic/Diastolic), measured by a Sphygmomanometer.
3. Heart sounds: 'Lub' (S1) is caused by closure of AV valves (tricuspid & bicuspid/mitral); 'Dub' (S2) is caused by closure of semilunar valves.
4. Pulmonary artery is the only artery carrying deoxygenated blood; Pulmonary vein is the only vein carrying oxygenated blood.
qe: In the human heart, which structure acts as the natural 'Pacemaker' that initiates rhythmic cardiac contractions?

q: आंत्र श्लेष्मा (ग्रहणी) द्वारा स्रावित कौन-सा एंजाइम निष्क्रिय अग्न्याशयी ट्रिप्सिनोजेन को सक्रिय ट्रिप्सिन में परिवर्तित करता है?
e:
Enterokinase (Enteropeptidase), secreted by the brush border of the duodenum, converts Trypsinogen → Trypsin; active Trypsin then activates Chymotrypsinogen and Procarboxypeptidase (एंटेरोकाइनेज ट्रिप्सिनोजेन को ट्रिप्सिन में सक्रिय करता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Pancreatic juice is called 'Complete Digestive Juice' because it contains enzymes for carbohydrates (amylase), proteins (trypsin, chymotrypsin), fats (lipase), and nucleic acids (nucleases).
2. Intestinal juice is called 'Succus entericus' (pH ~7.8).
3. Brunner's glands in the duodenum submucosa secrete alkaline mucus to neutralize acidic chyme from the stomach.
4. Peyer's patches are lymphoid follicles in the ileum providing gut immunity.
qe: Which enzyme, secreted by the intestinal mucosa (duodenum), activates inactive pancreatic Trypsinogen into active Trypsin?

q: पेयजल में मल संदूषण (faecal contamination) का पता लगाने के लिए विश्व स्तर पर किस सूचक जीव (indicator organism) का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e:
Escherichia coli (thermotolerant faecal coliform bacteria) is the WHO-recommended gold-standard indicator of recent faecal contamination in drinking water (पेयजल में मल संदूषण का मानक सूचक जीवाणु E. coli है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. WHO drinking water guideline requires 0 E. coli / 100 mL of potable water.
2. Major waterborne diseases caused by faecal-oral transmission include Cholera, Typhoid, Hepatitis A & E, Polio, and Amoebiasis.
3. Residual free chlorine (~0.2–0.5 mg/L) after chlorination ensures microbial safety in piped water supply; bleaching powder is CaOCl₂.
4. Jal Jeevan Mission (launched Aug 2019) aims to provide safe Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household.
qe: Which of the following waterborne diseases is correctly paired with the primary hygiene/sanitation indicator organism used globally to detect faecal contamination of drinking water?
